lecture_10.title: CS336 Spring 2026, Lecture 10: Inference
lecture_10.note: Line anchors refer to the local shallow clone (sha256 e79acd91..., recorded in discovered.json). Unlike lectures 2 and 6, nothing in this file runs on a GPU: every @inspect value (intensity, accelerator_intensity, b1/b64/b256, k40_b64/k8_b64/k8_b256, x_quant/x_approx) is sympy or plain Python arithmetic on the formulas at L128-L150, L188-L248, L291-L306 and L455-L459, so this thread re-evaluates and states them. What this thread does NOT restate is any number that lives only in an embedded figure (gqa-speed.png, gqa-accuracy.png, mla-accuracy*.png, cla-results.png, speculative-sampling-results/stats.png, pruning-kd.png, the baseten fp8 image): those are measurements from the cited papers and are recorded only as 'shown'. The AWQ '4x lower memory, 3.2x speedup' (L486) and DeepSeek-V2 '16384 to 512' (L411) are text() claims the professor reads off the papers; they are quoted with that attribution, not asserted.
